title: VibeSync
tagline: AI-powered DJ setlists personalized through NFT-gated vibes, where attendees influence the music and get a post-show playlist to relive the night.
description: VibeSync is an AI-powered music experience that bridges blockchain technology with real-world concerts, transforming NFT ownership into a dynamic, participatory event. At its core, VibeSync enables DJs to create and manage NFT-gated concerts where attendees actively shape the setlist by inputting their “vibes” during ticket purchase. These vibes—on-chain representations of audience sentiment—are processed by our AI agent to generate a curated setlist tailored to the event’s mood, genre, and DJ preferences. The experience extends beyond the concert itself; after the show, each attendee’s NFT is updated with the finalized setlist, preserving the night’s musical journey. By integrating decentralized ticketing, AI-driven personalization, and dynamic metadata updates, VibeSync offers a fully immersive way for artists and fans to connect, co-create, and relive unforgettable performances.
how_its_made: VibeSync is a TypeScript application integrating OpenZeppelin contracts, CDP OnchainKit, Irys datachain, and The Graph. The smart contracts, deployed on Base Sepolia, allow DJs to create NFT collections tied to upcoming concerts, with minters inputting their vibe at mint, which is stored on-chain. The Graph indexes collection creation and minting, enabling structured querying without relying on direct RPC calls to generate a setlist based on the on-chain vibe data and DJ set parameters like genre and set length. The AI-generated setlist is stored on Irys datachain, leveraging its simulated mutability to update metadata after the event. By combining decentralized event tracking with AI-driven music curation, VibeSync transforms NFTs into living artifacts that capture and evolve with real-world musical experiences.
